mapper.select: select ppl.problem_id as problem_id, p.title as title, ppl.score as score, sum(IF(status = 1, 1, 0)) as right_num, sum(IF(status = 1, 0, 1)) as wrong_num, sum(IF(ISNULL(status), 1, 0)) as absent_num, avg(r.score) as average from problem_problem_list ppl left join contest c on c.list_id = ppl.list_id and c.del_flag = 0 left join contest_records r on r.problem_id = ppl.problem_id left join problem p on p.problem_id = ppl.problem_id and p.del_flag = 0 where c.contest_id = #{contestId} group by ppl.problem_id

select uc.user_id as user_id, sum(IF(status = 1, 1, 0)) as right_num, sum(IF(status = 1, 0, 1)) as wrong_num, sum(IF(ISNULL(status), 1, 0)) as absent_num, sum(cr.score) as score
from user_contest uc left join contest_records cr on uc.contest_id = cr.contest_id where uc.contest_id = #{contestId} group by uc.user_id

select c.user_id as userId, cr.status as correct, cr.score as score from user_contest c left join contest_records cr on cr.user_id = c.user_id and cr.problem_id = ${problemId} and c.contest_id = #{contestId}

select ppl.problem_id as problemId, p.title as title, cr.status as correct, cr.score as score from problem_problem_list ppl left join db_problem.problem p on ppl.problem_id = p.problem_id left join contest_records cr on p.problem_id = cr.problem_id and cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = #{userId}
